business_summary: Techstorm Advanced Material Corporation Limited engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of chemical products for wind turbine blades and new composite materialsin China and internationally. It offers adhesives; mold resin and various auxiliary adhesive systems; pultrusion, filament-winding, flame retardants, infusion, hand lay-up, and mold resin; cementing compounds, industrial adhesives, energy storage battery structural adhesives, and thermal conductive structural adhesives; and materials for battery, motor, and electric control systems. The company also provides epoxy resin insulation materials for electrical equipment in power systems; silicone sealants and silicone potting adhesives for solar photovoltaic modules; gas cylinder wound resins, cable mandrel pultrusion resins, flame retardant resins, carbon fiber prepregs, HP-RTM resins, prepreg resins, and prepregs; and wind power blade glass fiber and carbon fiber pultrusion girder resin series. It serves wind power, new energy vehicles, energy storage, hydrogen energy, aviation, oil and gas exploitation, electric power, mold manufacturing, photovoltaic, consumer electronics, semiconductor, rail transit, 3D printing, 5G communications, shipping, building materials, and other new energy fields. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
